typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SensorID as string,
		EquipmentID as string,
		Timestamp as timestamp,
		Temperature as double,
		Pressure as double,
		SpeedRPM as short,
		Vibration as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['bronze/scada/**/*.csv']) ~> BronzeSCADASource
BronzeSCADASource derive(SourceTimestamp = toUTC(Timestamp),
		Temperature = round((Temperature - 32) * 5/9, 2),
		Pressure = round(Pressure * 0.0689476, 2)) ~> CleanseAndStandardize
CleanseAndStandardize split(Temperature <= 200 && !isNull(SensorID),
	disjoint: false) ~> QualityGate@(ValidData, BadData)
QualityGate@ValidData sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'parquet',
	umask: 0022,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> SilverSink
QualityGate@BadData sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	umask: 0022,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> QuarantineSink
